==Summary==
{{pov|[[Min Farshaw]]}}

[[Min Farshaw|Min]] flees the ''[[damane]]'' quarters as [[Renna]] punishes [[Egwene]] for channeling without permission and blames herself. She hears her name being called and turns to find [[Elayne]] and [[Nynaeve]] disguised in long fleece coats. She tells them of her meeting with [[Bayle Domon]] and her plan to escape [[Falme]] on a ship. Domon wants to leave but is afraid to do so because of the threat of the ''damane''. Min senses that if she just keeps talking to him, he will talk himself into leaving. But now the [[Seanchan]] plan to take Egwene back across the [[Aryth Ocean]] because she can find ore, so time is running out.

Min has new viewings of Nynaeve and Elayne which mean trouble for both sometime in the future.
*a man's ring of heavy gold above Nynaeve's head
*a red-hot iron and an axe above Elayne's head

The three women go down to the [[Three Plum Blossoms]] Inn near the docks to meet Domon. Domon says that [[Turak]] sends for him every two or three days to tell Turak about old artifacts, and he is concerned that Turak will kill him once he is no longer interesting. He would leave now except he is afraid that the ''damane'' would tear his ship apart. Nynaeve shows him her [[Great Serpent ring]] to give him confidence that he can escape. At the same time Min sees [[Lan]]'s [[Golden Crane signet ring]] from her viewing a short time before. Nynaeve promises that he will have three channelers to aid in his escape and Domon agrees to be able to sail at an instant any time in the next few days. But he tells Nynaeve that he witnessed an [[Aes Sedai]] captured by the [[Seanchan]], her [[Warder]] killed. As Doman watched, six ''damane'' surrounded her. She screamed, then yelled out to one of the ''damane'' "Ryma, help me." This Ryma is likely the same [[Ryma Galfrey|Ryma]] Egwene mentioned meeting to Min. Doman sees one of the ''damane'' then collapse in tears. They leave the inn and Nynaeve comments that they still have one or two ''small'' problems to solve before they can take ship.
